LB::src_tag
Description
Sets the source tag for the current request
Syntax
LB
::
src_tag
"source_tag"
LB::src_tag <source_tag>
Sets the source tag for the current request. The tag will be recorded
as a key to the current connection (to be looked up by destination
tag next time).
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
LB
::
src_tag
boo_tag
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
Valid Events:
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
CLIENT_DATA
SERVER_CONNECTED
SERVER_DATA
